title: Coverage Is Not Redundancy: Maintenance Cost and Exposure of Query-Aware Admission Indexes in Vector Databases Under Workload Drift
abstract: arXiv:2608.16043v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In a vector database serving production-scale retrieval, a single inserted document can be retrieved for an anomalously large share of the query workload -- a retrieval hub -- and dominate the evidence returned for an entire topic. An emerging defense guards against this at ingest with an admission check: it maintains a set of sentinel queries and admits a document only if its reverse-kNN count against them stays below a threshold tau. Under workload drift this sentinel set is a query-aware auxiliary index that must be maintained online, and we study the cost that maintenance imposes on the ingest path. We identify a structural limit -- coverage is not redundancy: a monitor stops promoting sentinels once a region is covered, but the predicate rejects a hub only once tau sentinels witness it, so exposure has an observation-limited floor that no reduction in update or enforcement latency can close. translated_title: 覆盖率并非冗余：向量数据库中查询感知准入索引在工作负载漂移下的维护成本与暴露度
translated_abstract: 在服务于生产级检索的向量数据库中，单个插入的文档可能被异常大量的查询工作负载所检索——即检索枢纽——并主导整个主题返回的证据。一种新兴的防御措施在摄取时通过准入检查来防范这一问题：它维护一组哨兵查询，并且仅当文档对这些哨兵的反k近邻计数低于阈值tau时才允许其被摄入。在工作负载漂移下，该哨兵集是一个查询感知的辅助索引，必须在线维护，我们研究了这种维护对摄取路径施加的成本。我们识别出一个结构性限制——覆盖率并非冗余：一旦某个区域被覆盖，监控器就会停止提升哨兵，但谓词仅在tau个哨兵见证到枢纽时才拒绝它，因此暴露度有一个观测限制的下限，任何更新或强制执行延迟的减少都无法弥补。我们在真实的HNSW、IVF-Flat和IVF-PQ索引上进行了实验。
tldr: 本文发现向量数据库中查询感知准入索引的维护存在结构性限制，即覆盖率无法替代冗余观测，导致暴露度存在无法通过降低延迟消除的下限。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies a structural limit in query-aware admission index maintenance for vector databases, where coverage cannot substitute for redundant observation, resulting in an exposure floor that latency reductions cannot eliminate.
